programme.desc: El duelo ha terminado y todos se dirigen a la oficina para votar. Sigifredo es el encargado de contar los votos, pero los resultados serán alterados. Por otro lado, Martin y Emiliano hablan de la llegada de este a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario y Emiliano cantan a dúo muy enamorados. Mientras tanto, Martin se va llorando para el hotel. Por otro lado, Emiliano le dice a Rosario que su familia ya consiguió la plata para el pasaje y que se va en unos días, pero promete volver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo celebra el bautizo de su nieta en compañía del grupo de mariachis. Por otro lado, Martin llega a México y le informa a Steve que va para el rancho a confesarle la verdad a Roberto Sanchez. Steve pondrá sobre aviso a Corona.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: Nobody knew about suburban dad Michael Hendricks' dark sexual fantasies or his dangerous dalliance with Maggie Ybarra. Behind closed doors, Hendricks and Ybarra nurtured a secret relationship that would turn deadly. In her first-ever interview, Ybarra reveals to host David Scott what it was like to fall under the spell of the Devil Next Door - and how their twisted partnership ended with abusive mind games, a shocking murder, and an innocent life destroyed.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: When flames tore through a Buffalo, New York home in 2018, the investigation revealed a toxic relationship and a hot-tempered arsonist, Frank Bredt, Jr. Now Bredt is talking about his crime from behind bars. In this episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott revisits the fire, the evidence, and the unraveling timeline - exposing a jilted lover hidden behind smoke and destruction and giving viewers an unfiltered look into the chilling death of an innocent mother.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: In his first ever television interview, killer Thomas Gilbert, Jr. discusses the murder that shook New York's elite. The Princeton-educated Gilbert became a tabloid obsession when he shot his father after his $1,000 allowance was cut off. But in this unique installment of Interview With a Killer, Gilbert appears to be a far cry from his once golden upbringing. Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: She's one of the most camera-friendly killers in true crime history. A glamorous Texas social climber turned convicted black widow. Celeste Beard Johnson has done many television interviews, flashing a smile as she proclaims her innocence and pleads for sympathy. But she's never been questioned by David Scott. And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.

programme.desc: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale. But this only masks deeper problems with the couple.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district--moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa's wedding is only three days away, but Dog is thinking about bounties, not bouquets. A hot jump has comes in and Dog wants to go on the hunt.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive has a bad reputation and a knack for running from the law. The pursuit has Dog and team traveling through an urban dystopia of suspicion, false leads and mistrust.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: What looks like a routine pick-up turns into a complicated case of betrayal, deceit, as well as quality nail care as Dog and company track down an fugitive alleged to be an abusive boyfriend with one too many friends in his close knit community.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and Beth take time from their busy schedule to thank their fans by inviting them into their home to celebrate the holiday season. But when Dog decides he needs to help his son Garry believe in Santa Claus again the plan changes.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive he always promises them that it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog doesn't know it yet, but today's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills.

programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy and today he's proving it. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct?In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask:When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles

In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood forstrong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching intoclassrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintainingbalance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Wilderness Chronicles - "Killer Croc's Warning The True Story Of Brett Mann
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett's body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn't just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Wilderness Chronicles - "Are Dinosaurs Still Alive In The African Congo?
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what's really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.sub-title: The Green Way Outdoors - "The Everglades Python
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.sub-title: The Green Way Outdoors - "Oklahoma Catfish Noodling
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "2022 Kentucky Whitetail Velvet Opener
programme.desc: Mark Peterson and Earl Peterson are headed down to Kentucky for the opening of deer season. With this being the earliest that a bowhunter can hunt whitetails, it can result in a giant velvet whitetail harvest. After a fun night enjoying the Swon Brothers' music, it's time to dial the bow in, freshen up the Buck Bourbon at feed sites and hope that Brows or Kevins' buck show themselves. How will the story end on the Giant Deer named Brows?

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Giant Kentucky Velvet Whitetails
programme.desc: About 2-3 months ago Mark purchased a 300+ acre farm in Kentucky. After running trail cameras and putting food plots on the farm, Mark now has the chance to get in the stand on opening day of Kentucky's bow season. There have been plenty of shooter bucks on the farm but only a few still are holding their velvet. Mark has his sights set on a Giant Kentucky Velvet Whitetail. The day before opening day Salt River puts on a celebration that features the @theswonbrothers.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson sets his sights on a Free-Range New Zealand Red Stag, but it doesn't come easy. Dense fog, steep terrain, and thick vegetation make finding a mature stag no easy task. Watch as Mark Peterson and his guide cover the gorgeous New Zealand landscape in search of one of the most sought-after big game animals on the South Island of New Zealand. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd again have to borrow from his guide.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Northern Cape of South Africa: Axis and Fallow Deer
programme.desc: Through the rugged terrain of South Africa's Northern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out in pursuit of a rare and thrilling double, the Axis and Fallow Deer. Though non-native, these species have flourished in the region's diverse habitat. Join Mark on this unforgettable experience under the African skies, during this unique hunting experience in South Africa.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.sub-title: The Bearded Buck - "Third Times A Charm
programme.desc: Illinois is one of those coveted midwestern states that every whitetail hunter dreams of hunting. In this episode, Jerry and Austin finally make their way to this buck paradise to hunt with our good friends Jack Ficarra and Dylan Thomsen at 5 Seasons Outfitters. With rut kicking off, the guys are hoping that they will get to experience some of the magic that Illinois is known for.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.sub-title: American Heroes Outdoors - "Hurricane Ian Aftermath With The Sanibel Fire Department
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Southwest Florida and connect with the Sanibel Fire Department to highlight and claim witness to the devastation left behind from Hurricane Ian. The magnitude and amount of destruction is hard to capture, but you'll see that the American spirit still shines through all the rubble. We also honor our next Scheels hometown hero, Rod Wilson!

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Huevos rancheros
programme.desc: Una mujer le es infiel a su esposo porque ella cree que de esa manera le evitará una muerte sangrienta.

programme.title: La casa que arde de noche
programme.desc: Una prostituta ingresa en un burdel y establece una rivalidad con la dueña del lugar. Luego, trata de arrebatarle el negocio y al amante a la anciana propietaria.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: El Quelite
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene una sensación extraña cada vez que escucha la música de una canción.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El hombre del puente
programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado
programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Espejismo de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Una familia campesina vende todas sus posesiones y se muda a la ciudad, donde encuentran grandes dificultades y dolor.

programme.title: Venganza suicida
programme.desc: Una joven sobrevive a un asalto, en el que muere toda su familia. Luego, aprende a manejar armas y se dedica a buscar a los asesinos para matarlos.

programme.title: Fotógrafo de Modelos
programme.desc: Un fotógrafo recibe herencia millonaria de su abuela a condición de que se purifique de vicios y mujeres por un año.

programme.title: Huevos rancheros
programme.desc: Una mujer le es infiel a su esposo porque ella cree que de esa manera le evitará una muerte sangrienta.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: El Tejedor de Milagros
programme.desc: En Navidad, un indio llega a un pueblo con su esposa embarazada; pero como nadie los ayuda ella da a luz en plena calle.

programme.title: La mesera del café del puerto
programme.desc: Una mesera coja ayuda a un compositor que está en la ruina, logrando superarse y triunfar, luego ella se somete a una cirugía y deciden casarse.

programme.title: Los hijos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un comerciante queda viudo con cinco hijos a su cargo, quienes le dan severos problemas con su comportamiento.

programme.title: El hombre de la isla
programme.desc: Una mujer va a una isla remota para casarse con un hombre que al principio la maltrata, pero al fin se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Rancho de mis recuerdos
programme.desc: Un caporal se luce en una fiesta brava junto a un torero andaluz y la hija del hacendado les hace competencia.

programme.title: Azahares para tu boda
programme.desc: La hija de una familia conservadora va a casarse, pero el novio socialista no acepta hacerlo por la iglesia.

programme.title: Muertos de miedo
programme.desc: Una joven contrata a dos detectives privados para encontrar a un famoso ladrón de joyas, conocido como Rostov.

programme.title: El pequeño ruiseñor
programme.desc: Un pequeño monaguillo tiene una voz prodigiosa así que en complicidad con el sacristán canta en bodas y bautizos.

programme.title: Vivir del cuento
programme.desc: Un empleado usa el nombre de su patrón para cometer fraude y es despedido, pero a su vez el patrón engaña a su ex-suegro.

programme.title: El beisbolista fenómeno
programme.desc: Un excelente beisbolista muere y supuestamente su espíritu entra en un vagabundo que empieza a jugar como todo un profesional.

programme.title: Extraña Cita
programme.desc: Una bella joven trata de vengarse de la muerte de su padre y sufre humillaciones mientras lo hace.

programme.title: Los tales por cuales
programme.desc: Un ranchero llega a un pueblo donde se atribuyen varios delitos al cacique y lo salva de varios atentados.

programme.title: La familia Pérez
programme.desc: Una familia, excesiva en sus pretensiones, aprende varias lecciones sobre humildad, amor y unión familiar.

programme.title: Una gallega en México

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don is at Longmeadow with a host of seasonal jobs to keep his autumn garden looking beautiful for as long as possible, and in the third of her fascinating films about how plants work, Carol Klein investigates the science of stems.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty helps two pairs of amateur gardeners who want to create dream gardens in very different urban spaces. In Bromley, Mei and Gerard have ambitious plans to turn their narrow, split-level garden into a Japanese paradise.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Clapham, a young couple, Jack and Chris, want to turn their tiny urban backspace into a Victorian inspired plant collector's paradise with a high-tech twist.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don meets two sets of gardeners who are desperate for his help and advice to turn their outside spaces into dream gardens. In Worthing, Emma and Josh want to create a family garden for their little boy, Noah, who has Down Syndrome.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets going on a new planting project, gives advice on planting for east- and west- facing borders, starts reaping summer vegetables and sows seeds for autumn harvests.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is keeping on top of seasonal maintenance at Longmeadow, Adam Frost travels to Sissinghurst Castle to view a new area of the garden, and in West Sussex we get tips on growing the perfect dahlia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Carol Klein and Nick Bailey celebrate gardeners throughout the country who have created some truly unique gardens and made every space count. Carol meets a couple in Dorset whose garden is full of inspirational features.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty welcomes a special guest, the Duchess of Cornwall, to Longmeadow, where she shares her love of gardening. Nick Bailey visits Knoll Gardens and gives his tips on the tall perennials which give a burst of colour towards the end of the season.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow, enjoying the colours of late summer in the garden. Adam Frost, Carol Klein and Frances Tophill get an exclusive preview of Gardeners' World Live at the NEC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow with plenty of seasonal advice to keep gardens colourful. Will Young shows off his south London courtyard garden and reveals why it has become an absolute joy in his life.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets some shrubs in the ground and plans ahead for spring with some bulb planting. Meanwhile, Frances Tophill joins Sue Kent on her allotment to find out how her growing year has been.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, but the garden is letting them down, and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Jennifer enlists the help of her sisters to create an Italian-themed garden in memory of their parents. She has great ideas and a budget to match, but growing citrus trees, olive trees and vines in a leafy London suburb is easier said than done.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits gardens in Florence and the Tuscan countryside, discovering that renaissance gardens were created as works of art.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in Naples visiting some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the scenery of the Amalfi Coast.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by a display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.sub-title: A Return to Manassas: The Second Battle of Bull Run

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The diverse terrains hinder troop formations and make the soldiers vulnerable to attacks during the Antietam battle. This results in intense fighting and many casualties.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The war photographers provide an up-close look at the devastation caused during the Antietam battle. Compassionate medics like Clara Barton go down in history as heroes.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The politically driven decision to replace McClellan with Burnside leads the Union soldiers to their doom in Fredericksburg.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Victory comes at a heavy price for Robert E. Lee in the Battle of Chancellorsville after he employs some arguably high-risk battle strategies.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: Andrée de Jongh and the Resistance
programme.desc: When the Germans begin their rapid invasions across Europe, many ordinary citizens are stunned; Dedee de Jongh, a 23-year-old nurse, builds an escape line through Belgium and France to rescue stranded British airmen; her courage and ingenuity.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: The Tory Rebels Who Helped Save England
programme.desc: In hindsight, it may appear inevitable that Winston Churchill takes command; at the time, it seems unthinkable that Neville Chamberlain steps down; how a few brave politicians orchestrate one of the most striking political transitions in history.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: Victor de Laveleye and V for Victory
programme.desc: As an Olympic athlete, Victor de Laveleye is not an ordinary man; there is no reason to think he comes up with one of the war's most popular symbols, helping to buoy spirits and wage psychological warfare; the story of the V for Victory campaign.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: Wilhelmina and Haakon: Royalty Fight Back
programme.desc: When the Germans invade the Netherlands and Norway, Adolf Hitler wants to secure the leadership of these nations; the wrenching decisions and harrowing escapes of Queen Wilhelmina and King Haakon; how these royal figures fight the war from Britain.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: Polish Pilots and the Battle of Britain
programme.desc: The RAF's air battle to defend Britain from Germany in 1940; few people know that roughly 20 percent of the RAF consists of non-British pilots; witnessing the courage and successful maneuvers of Polish fighter pilots who save the day.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: Wendell Willkie: "A Godsend to This Country"
programme.desc: It might seem impossible to find a politician willing to sabotage his own campaign; that is exactly what Wendell Willkie does in his 1940 run against President Roosevelt: why he goes against his own party and supports FDR's plans to help Britain.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.sub-title: The Earl of Suffolk and Heavy Water
programme.desc: Charles Henry George Howard, the 20th Earl of Suffolk, is an Englishman who seems unlikely to be responsible for the future of the free world; how he smuggles French scientists to England; how he foils Nazi efforts to obtain a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: For years, the history books suggest there are no women leaders of the Resistance in France; the story of Marie-Madeleine Fourcade blows this theory out of the water; meeting this extraordinary woman; how she leads a spy ring throughout France.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: U.S. Marines arrive in June 1965 to protect a U.S. air base; the North Vietnamese Army and the southern Viet Cong guerrillas launch attacks.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: French Indochina and the Viet Minh
programme.desc: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: Dien Bien Phu and Vietnam Divided, 1953-1959
programme.desc: Examining mid-century Vietnam from the First Indochina War to the October 1955 referendum.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: Five Leaders Who Defined the Vietnam War
programme.desc: Explore the makings of war in Vietnam through five major players, starting with Vietnamese leaders Hồ Chí Minh and Lê Duẩn in the north and Ngo Dinh Diem in the south.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Viet Cong, 1959-1962
programme.desc: Examining why the northern Vietnamese government decided to wage guerilla war in the south, and how it's adversaries responded.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: In 1963, South Vietnam careens toward crisis; exploring the ARVN's deficiencies from lackluster military commanders to political legitimacy.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: The Gulf of Tonkin and a Crossroads, 1964
programme.desc: Examining how the specter of communism in neighboring Indonesia shaped calculations made by the United States.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.sub-title: The Vietnam War in the Skies
programme.desc: While the United States boasts an impressive air force, its air campaign struggles when confronted by VC forces.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.sub-title: Redcoats Fall to the Continental Army
programme.desc: Washington's army is in dire straits; his command is in question; he revives his reputation with the famous crossing of the Delaware River; the next four years of the American Revolution, which see Britain's strategic advantage deteriorate.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.sub-title: Andrew Jackson and the War of 1812
programme.desc: Why the United States chooses to fight Britain in the War of 1812; America's grievances and ambitions, which include the conquest of Canada; the poor strategy, command and training that lead to a strategic stalemate; the exception is Andrew Jackson.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: The continental U.S. reaches its present span due to the Mexican-American War; the strategies and tactics of generals Zachary Taylor and Winfield Scott; what disciplined and bold maneuvers conducted by a professional army can accomplish.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.sub-title: Opening Volleys of the Civil War: 1861-1862
programme.desc: The Civil War sets the pattern for warfare in the 20th and 21st centuries; the political events leading up to the war; the strategy devised by Winfield Scott; the chaotic First Battle of Bull Run; developments in the western theater.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: The ebb and flow of battle in the eastern theater; President Lincoln promotes and fires top commanders; The South faces instability in its top ranks until Robert E. Lee becomes the Rebel army's leader; following events through the Battle of Antietam.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: In the summer of 1863, the Civil War reaches a climax on two fronts; studying the generalship of Grant in isolating and defeating the Confederate force defending Vicksburg; dissecting Gen. George Meade's tactics that halt Lee's invasion of the North.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: How the Spanish's power hold on the Caribbean is broken; which nationalities join in the free-for-all; the historical importance of Alexander Exquemelin's "Buccaneers of America" and Captain Charles Johnson's "A General History of the Pyrates".

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Pirates want money or anything they can turn into money; consequently, they usually wish for a speedy surrender, do not want a battle and rarely sink captured ships; the many tactics pirates use to apprehend their prey in the age of sails.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Very few pirates hit it big or try to bury their treasure on a deserted island; exploring the business aspect of piracy, which is one of the few aspects of life pirates can control; piracy is a no-prey, no-pay system; the risk of no pay is very real.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.sub-title: The West in the Colonial Era
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.sub-title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.sub-title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded
programme.desc: The portrayal of the John the Baptist's death as the whim of the young femme fatale Salome; why the truth is much more complicated; the story of Salome's mother, Herodias; how Herodias's hunger for power and recognition left her exiled and forgotten.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400

programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.sub-title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.sub-title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded
programme.desc: The portrayal of the John the Baptist's death as the whim of the young femme fatale Salome; why the truth is much more complicated; the story of Salome's mother, Herodias; how Herodias's hunger for power and recognition left her exiled and forgotten.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.sub-title: The Trung Sisters of Vietnam Fight the Han
programme.desc: China under the Han Dynasty; how imperial expansion threatened the matriarchal culture of Vietnam; the Trung sisters; leading tribal armies against the invaders; how the Trung sisters' story has become a touchstone of Vietnamese culture.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The end of Iron Age Britain and the birth of Roman Britain; the valiant but thwarted rebellion of the Celtic warrior queen, Boudicca; how Boudicca was motivated by personal tragedy; the revival of Boudicca's legacy by Queen Victoria.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: Nero's reputation for excess and cruelty; how Poppaea became the wife of the mad emperor; how Poppaea's religious sympathies likely influenced Nero's persecution of Christians; a complex story of spiritual zeal and vicious cruelty.
